overview_description.description:
Chorus Sleep provides a program and application designed to assist workers in improving their sleep patterns.

It offers audio sessions and tools, sleep tracking and coaching, as well as interactive content.

Chorus Sleep's founders are Ali Abramovitz, MK Hurlbutt, and Warren Runk.

about_short_description.short_description: Chorus Sleep provides a program and application designed to assist workers in improving their sleep patterns.

product.name: Chorus Sleep App
product.description: A mobile application that tracks sleep, offers relaxation sessions, provides educational content, and supports at-home diagnostic tests to improve sleep quality.

product.name: Chorus Sleep Coaching Program
product.description: A personalized coaching service providing human support to help users follow their specific sleep improvement programs.

product.name: Employer Sleep Insights Dashboard
product.description: A tool for employers to anonymously measure and analyze employee sleep health, sentiment, and productivity data.

product.name: At-Home Sleep Diagnostic Tests
product.description: Home-based tests available through the app to diagnose sleep conditions such as sleep apnea and severe insomnia.

product.name: Sleep Apnea Device Procurement Service
product.description: A service facilitating quick and affordable access to sleep apnea devices for users diagnosed with the condition.
